fees.notes: International fee not published: programme is not listed with an international fee on StudyMalaysia and MSU official pages publish Malaysian fees only. Source: https://www.msu.edu.my (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: International students must achieve at least Band 2 in MUET or 4.0 in IELTS or equivalent. Pass screening test (drawing test and portfolio review). Pass interview session by industry partners (for scholarship/job guarantee). Entry via TVET route MQF Level 4 or 5 TVET in a relevant field. Diploma Lanjutan Kemahiran Malaysia (Level 5). Diploma Kemahiran Malaysia (Level 4) or Diploma Vokasional Malaysia with minimum CGPA 2.50 or less and at least 2 years experience. Entry via academic route Diploma or equivalent from IPTA/ILKA/IPTS. STPM with at least Grade C (NGMP 2.00) in 2 subjects including General Studies/Pengajian Am. STAM (2019 and earlier) with Jayyid; or Matriculation/Foundation (2020 and earlier) with minimum CGPA 2.00. APEL A: Adult learners with work experience who passed the assessment.
